steps.do: Find the email with email_search (sender, subject or words the user mentioned).
Read that email in full with email_read.
Write the reply in the user's voice and show it to them; ask if it's good to send or what to change.
Send the approved reply with email_send, using reply_to_id so it stays in the thread (they approve it on their phone).
Tell the user it was sent, in one short sentence.
